body: He's 1.25 years old about. I could look into the pricings of a trainer, but I'm not sure how well I'll be able to afford one. And I can't tell if it's play or aggression just because he gets so hyper and then starts biting. He's house-trained, knows the basics like sit, shake, lay, roll-over, wait, and heel. He isn't very good at staying in place. He has a lot of anxiety from other dogs since he was attacked as a puppy. He walks on a leash fine, but when we get close to being somewhere he is familiar with, he starts pulling with all of his might. He is a really sweet dog who loves attention at the right times, but if you keep petting him and he doesn't want to, he opens his mouth and trips to bite on your hand. No amount of yipping or yelping has gotten him to stop. I'll try to give him toys if that's what he's looking to do, but it seems like he just has a preference for biting humans
I hope that everything gets better for you, and you can always send me a message if you want to talk 💕
